releaseNotes: Refactor account management and backup features
changelog: Updated the ArrowProgress function to enhance the end angle calculation for smoother animations.
Modified the AboutScreen layout for improved spacing and alignment.
Streamlined the AccountScreen by removing unused dialogs and simplifying the UI for account actions.
Introduced the ExportImportScreen for managing backup and restore operations with improved user experience.
Added a new PanelIdentity utility to derive unique identity keys for panel connections.
Implemented delete account functionality in SecurityPrivacyScreen with confirmation dialog.
Updated theme management to use a more dynamic color scheme.
Added Arabic and English strings for backup file selection.
Created unit tests for panel identity key generation to ensure uniqueness and correctness.
